name: Purphoros
aliases: Purphoros, the God of the Forge
description: The God of the forge, fire and restless earth on Theros, whose forge burns within Mount Velus.

description_citations.text: "Purphoros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod's desire for praise brings him into savage conflict with Purphoros; Purphoros' blade falls and is taken by Elspeth.
timeline.quote: fell from the heavens and was taken by a frightened Elspeth

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Theran phoenix lays one egg in its life and plunges itself into its volcano at the end, upon which the egg hatches and a new phoenix is born.
timeline.quote: A phoenix lays just one egg during its centuries-long life

citation.text: "Phoenix", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Purphoros creates the Sword of Chaos to challenge Heliod; their battle disrupts the resting place of Polukranos, who rampages until Heliod and Nylea seal him.
timeline.quote: Purphoros once created the Sword of Chaos to challenge the sun god Heliod .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel arrives, witnesses Purphoros's sword being cast aside, claims it and departs.
timeline.quote: She claimed the sword for herself and later departed the plane.

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Purphoros is among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: Purphoros was among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Heliod has Daxos purge Meletis of other gods' influence, Purphoros and the others summon champions from the Underworld, Purphoros choosing Anax.
timeline.quote: Purphoros’s champion was Anax , former king of Akros .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora steals Dekella and Thassa receives a new divine spear from Purphoros.
timeline.quote: Dekella was later stolen by the planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Purphoros, inspired by his affair with Nylea, forges artificial unicorns from opal.
timeline.quote: inspired the god Purphoros to forge artificial unicorns from opal

citation.text: "Unicorn", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Iris gallops carelessly away from Alexio, and he swoops down and saves her from an ambush by two men he believes are worshipers of Purphoros; her horse is lamed and put down.
timeline.quote: Judging by the markings on their weapons, I would guess they were worshipers of Purphoros.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Deiphon tells the myth of how Purphoros's sword unleashed Polukranos and Heliod and Nylea bound the hydra.
timeline.quote: So in his destructive fury, he unleashed the mighty Polukranos from his home in the sky.

citation.work: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter
citation.text: "Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alexio rescues Iris from her horse and kills the two ambushers, whose weapons are Purphoran.
timeline.quote: The two men charged, but he killed them both in quick succession.

citation.text: "Alexio", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the war between the gods, Purphoros reforges Anax into a demigod who can only say 'Cymede'.
timeline.quote: During the war between the gods, Purphoros transformed Anax, reforging him into a demigod who can't think of anything but victory.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Perisophia has Iris escorted in secret by Alexio; Alexio is killed and Iris escapes on a pegasus.
timeline.quote: Alexio had been killed and Iris had escaped on a loyal pegasus

citation.text: "Perisophia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth comes into possession of a powerful sword forged by Purphoros; the gods grow paranoid, manipulated by Xenagos.
timeline.quote: each god was driven to paranoia and violence

citation.text: "Silence of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.
